groups.problem: zoho-bigin passes credentialId instead of the user's id as the userId argument to refreshOAuthTokens.
groups.rationale: All of these flag the same wrong argument at the same call site, and they all give the same fix.

groups.problem: Google Calendar saves the SafeParse result ({success, data}) as the credential key instead of its .data.
groups.rationale: All of these point to the same line, where the SafeParse wrapper is saved as the key, and they all suggest using .data.

groups.problem: The computed keys [z.string().toString()] in minimumTokenResponseSchema become literal property names, so validation always fails in sync mode.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same broken schema definition and suggest the same passthrough fix.

groups.problem: In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but callers such as Google expect a response object with .data.
groups.rationale: S21 reports the shape mismatch at the helper and S10 reports it at the Google call site. One normalisation fix resolves both.

groups.problem: The webhook secret is compared with !==, which is not constant-time and allows timing attacks.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison and recommend crypto.timingSafeEqual.
